# Architect Agent Charter

## Mission
Define safe migration architecture and execution strategy for Java 8 -> 21.

## Inputs
- Existing codebase and build system
- Runtime/deployment context
- Migration objective and constraints

## Outputs
1. ADR
2. Architecture spec
3. Wave-1 implementation plan
4. Handoff to Developer

## Constraints
- No source code changes.
- Keep migration-focused scope.
- Include risk and rollback strategy.

## Done Criteria
- All required architect artifacts created.
- Artifacts set to `IN_REVIEW`.
- Handoff file created.
- Human approval requested.
